en.name: Orange juice, carton
en.summary: An opened carton of orange juice keeps 7–10 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and it can be frozen for 8–12 months at −18 °C (0 °F). An unopened carton is good for about 1 week after the date printed on the package if it has been kept properly cold.
en.pantry: A chilled carton of orange juice is not a cupboard item. It is pasteurised rather than sterilised, so it depends on refrigeration from the dairy to your fridge, and a carton left out warms into the danger zone quickly. Follow the two-hour rule for a carton left on the counter — one hour if the room is above 32 °C — and get it back into the fridge as soon as you have poured. Shelf-stable UHT orange juice is a different product with its own printed date.
en.fridge: 7–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened, capped and on a shelf rather than in the door where the temperature rises every time someone opens it. An unopened carton is good for about 1 week after the date printed on the package, assuming it has stayed cold throughout. The juice will separate as it stands, which is normal — shake it. Pour into a glass rather than drinking from the carton; saliva shortens the window noticeably.
en.freezer: 8–12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Freezing a carton is a genuinely useful option when you have bought more than you can drink, but decant first: the juice expands and a full carton will split at the seams. Freeze it in portions in containers with headspace. It thaws slightly separated and a little duller in flavour, but it is perfectly good for drinking and excellent for cooking.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, then shake well. Treat thawed juice as opened juice and drink it within the refrigerated window.
spoilage: Fizzing or foaming when poured — fermentation has begun.
A sharp, alcoholic or vinegary smell instead of a fresh citrus one.
Mould at the spout, under the cap or on the surface.
tips: Keep the carton on a fridge shelf, not in the door.
Pour into a glass rather than drinking straight from the carton.
Decant before freezing; a full carton splits as the juice expands.
Wipe the spout before recapping — that is where mould starts.

faq.q: How long does carton orange juice last once opened?
faq.a: 7–10 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, capped and kept on a shelf.
Yes, 8–12 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Decant into containers with headspace first, because a full carton will split.

faq.q: Can you drink orange juice after the date on the carton?
faq.a: A carton that has stayed properly cold is good for about 1 week past the printed date. Smell it and look for fizzing before you pour.

zh.name: 盒裝柳橙汁
zh.summary: 開封後的盒裝柳橙汁放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 7～10 天，冷凍 −18 °C 則是 8～12 個月。未開封的紙盒若全程確實冷藏，在包裝標示日期之後大約還有 1 週。
zh.pantry: 冷藏櫃的盒裝柳橙汁不是櫥櫃食品。它是巴氏殺菌而不是滅菌，所以從乳品廠到你家冰箱全程都靠冷藏撐著；放在外面很快就會升進危險溫度帶。放在檯面上的紙盒請遵守兩小時原則——室溫超過 32 °C 時只有一小時——倒完就趕快放回冰箱。常溫架上的超高溫殺菌柳橙汁是不同的產品，以它自己的標示日期為準。
zh.fridge: 開封後蓋緊、放 4 °C 以下冷藏 7～10 天，並且放層架而不是冰箱門——門邊每次有人開門溫度就上升一次。未開封的紙盒若全程保持冷藏，在包裝標示日期之後大約還有 1 週。果汁靜置會分層，這很正常，搖一搖就好。請倒進杯子喝，不要對著紙盒口喝，唾液會明顯縮短這個窗口。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下，自購買日起 8～12 個月。買太多喝不完時，冷凍是真的有用的選項，但要先倒出來：果汁結凍會膨脹，裝滿的紙盒會從接縫裂開。請分裝進留有膨脹空間的容器。解凍後會稍微分層、風味也淡一點，但拿來喝完全沒問題，入菜更是好用。
zh.thawing: 請放冷藏解凍，不要放檯面上，之後搖勻。解凍後就當成已開封的果汁，在冷藏的期限內喝完。
spoilage: 倒出來起泡或冒沫——發酵開始了。
聞起來尖酸、有酒味或醋味，而不是新鮮的柑橘香。
開口處、蓋子內側或液面長霉。
tips: 紙盒放冰箱層架，不要放門邊。
倒進杯子喝，不要直接對著紙盒口喝。
要冷凍請先倒出來；裝滿的紙盒會被撐裂。
蓋回去之前擦一下開口，霉都是從那裡開始的。

faq.q: 盒裝柳橙汁開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊放冰箱層架，4 °C 以下 7～10 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 8～12 個月。請先倒進留有膨脹空間的容器，裝滿的紙盒會裂開。

faq.q: 過了紙盒上的日期還能喝嗎？
faq.a: 全程確實冷藏的紙盒，在標示日期之後大約還有 1 週。倒之前先聞一下、看看有沒有起泡。
